g.text: Totals: which app counts an ascent
Boardsesh counts an ascent until it sees that ascent in a pull from the manufacturer. From then on the manufacturer counts it.
Example: two climbers send one climb at 40 degrees.
A climber who has not linked
Once a day, Boardsesh pushes its totals to
the manufacturer, per climb and angle, as
numbers only: senders, ratings, grade votes.
The two counts agree within about a day.
While a send moves from one count to
the other, it can be counted twice or not at all.
The next daily push corrects it.
